description: Wigan Council is a metropolitan borough authority. Default is procurement_paid. Wigan does NOT redact individual payments at the published threshold so direct_payment_individual rules are inactive by default. Greater Manchester Pension Fund payments bucket to internal_transfer. Audit corpus on first run to confirm.

rules.reason: Defensive REDACTED rule — pattern in case Wigan begins publishing redacted Care Act direct payments.

Wigan LGPS contributions to the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (administered by Tameside MBC) are internal-transfer from general fund to the council's own pension vehicle, not third-party procurement.
